interpretation.filesystem_cache: Logical payload may be served by the OS cache. Logical bytes minus attributed bytes does not measure exact cache-hit bytes because accounting scope and timing differ.
interpretation.lower_bound: Inner delta bounds the observed monotone process counter increase for this run only. It is not an algorithmic, attainable future-run, or physical-I/O lower bound.
interpretation.hardware_ceiling: No sustainable physical SSD service bandwidth or 20tokens/s hardware ceiling follows from these logical/process counts.

reproducibility: Use analyze-process-brackets.py boundary algorithm on these two saved inputs, after explicitly rejecting failed samples within phases and excluding the recorded late ESRCH sample.
